soldier: Soldier head chestnut brown tinged with red, pronotum chestnut brown, abdomen pale chestnut brown. Head capsule rectangular, fontanelle flat, almost not projecting. Antennae 13–14-segmented, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 about 3 times segment 2. Compound eyes bulging. Labrum semicircular. Mandible apices rather curved and slightly upturned; the left mandible about 0.67 times the length of the head capsule and 0.105 times the greatest width of the head; lacinia of the maxilla with 11 marginal bristles. Anterior margin of the pronotum broadly V-shaped, with a U-shaped median incision, the posterior margin shallowly concave at the centre, the midline faintly visible.
